title: Shared definitions
description: Building blocks shared by the v1 control-frame and job-channel schemas. Not a frame by itself.

v.description: Protocol version carried by every control frame. Always 1 in v1. Neither side checks it today (known-gaps G1).

cid.description: Channel id minted by the hub: uuid4 as 32 lowercase hex digits (src/alb/remote/protocol.py:152-161). The bench treats it as an opaque routing key and echoes it back.

csecret.description: Per-channel secret minted by the hub: secrets.token_urlsafe(32), 43 base64url characters (src/alb/remote/protocol.py:164-176). Sent only on the signaling connection; presented back as the x-alb-csecret header on dial-back.

opName.description: Name of an op in the bench op table. Same shape the hub enforces when it reads a table (src/alb/remote/bench_ops.py:38).

build.description: First 12 hex digits of the sha256 of the bench program file, or empty when the file could not be read (clients/windows-agent/alb_agent.py:118-131).

sha256.description: sha256 of an image, 64 lowercase hex digits (hub: hashlib hexdigest; bench lower-cases before comparing, clients/windows-agent/alb_agent.py:3515).

errorCode.description: An error code from the hub catalogue (src/alb/infra/errors.py), or empty. Two bench failure paths send an empty code (clients/windows-agent/alb_agent.py:3238, 3575).
